name: array-mutual
source:
-- | Exercise one sealed finite-payload typing contract.
module Main where
  -- | The first member of a mutually recursive group.
  data First where
    -- | Carry the second member inside a finite array.
    First :: Array Second -> First
  -- | Complete the group with a direct positive field.
  data Second where
    -- | Retain the first member directly.
    Second :: First -> Second
  -- | Keep the fixture executable independent from its unused type declarations.
  main :: Int
  main = 0
